TC_COMBO.title: Element Combo: {Element} · {Remaining} left
TC_COMBO.description:
Recorded: [gold]{Element}[/gold]. [blue]{Remaining}[/blue]/{Limit} combos left this turn.
Wind ↔ Rock: +[blue]{BlockBonus}[/blue] Block.
Rock ↔ Lightning: [blue]{AttackBonus}[/blue] base attack: defensive skills hit a random living enemy; targeted attacks follow up on their original enemy.
Lightning ↔ Wind: draw [blue]{DrawBonus}[/blue].
A combo retains the element just played for the next combo; other cards preserve it. The element persists between turns and clears only when combat ends.
TC_COMBO.exhaustedDescription: 0/{Limit} combos left. Recorded: {Element}. Theme cards only resolve base effects. Resets to {Limit} next turn.
TC_RULES.title: Element Combo
TC_RULES.description:
Manually play two different elements, in either order: Wind/Rock grants 4 Block; Rock/Lightning deals a 4-base attack; Lightning/Wind draws 1. All pairs share 3 uses per player per turn. A combo retains the element just played: Wind/Rock/Wind triggers twice; Wind/Rock/Lightning triggers both adjacent pairs. Other cards preserve it; the same element updates the record. Auto plays and extra resolutions do not advance it. Paimon doubles rewards.
Rock/Lightning triggered by a skill with no enemy target attacks one random living enemy. Targeted attacks follow up on their original living enemy; a dead target is never replaced. Skip rewards if base effects end combat. Native attack modifiers and draw restrictions apply.
Journey/Unbound Compass raises the limit to 4. Thunder Echo adds 2 base attack/Block and 1 draw; it does not stack with Paimon.

TC_WIND_GUIDANCE.title: Wind Guidance
TC_WIND_GUIDANCE.description: After the first actual Wind–Lightning or Wind–Rock reward each turn, draw {Amount} extra card(s). Both share one trigger; copies add together.
TC_ROCK_HEART.title: Rock Heart
TC_ROCK_HEART.description: Protect up to {Amount} existing Block at turn end. Block spent against enemies is not recreated.
TC_THUNDER_ECHO.title: Thunder Echo
TC_THUNDER_ECHO.description: Each copy adds 2 to base combo attacks and Block and 1 to combo draws. Active copies: {Amount}. Does not stack with Paimon; use the higher reward.
TC_ELEMENT_RESONANCE.title: Element Resonance
TC_ELEMENT_RESONANCE.description: After your second actual combo reward each turn, gain {Amount} Energy. Skipped follow-ups, zero damage, and drawing zero do not count.
TC_FIRST_ELEMENT_RESONANCE.title: Element Resonance+
TC_FIRST_ELEMENT_RESONANCE.description: After your first actual combo reward each turn, gain {Amount} Energy. Triggers separately from unupgraded Resonance.
TC_TRIPHASE_INFUSION.title: Triphase Infusion
TC_TRIPHASE_INFUSION.description: At turn start gain a random element. A different element attempts one normal combo; a matching element grants {Amount} temporary Dexterity this turn. Copies share one roll.
